name: cve-dockerfile-benchmark
description: A benchmark of Dockerfiles and associated CVE-related examples intended to evaluate models on detecting, classifying, and potentially suggesting fixes for container configuration vulnerabilities. It measures code-understanding and security-detection capabilities, focusing on real-world misconfigurations and insecure patterns in Dockerfiles.
reputation: A security-focused dataset referenced by researchers working on ML-driven vulnerability detection for infrastructure-as-code, but with limited mainstream adoption.
